evals.prompt: Create a skill named incident-postmortem in skills/incident-postmortem/. It turns incident notes I paste (chat exports with timestamps) into a blameless postmortem: summary, impact with numbers, timeline in UTC, root cause and contributing factors, action items each with an owner and a due date. It should fire when I paste incident notes and ask for a postmortem or incident review. The requirements are final and approved: write the skill and its evals to disk now, no need to ask me anything.
evals.expected_output: A complete skill folder on disk.
assertions: Writes skills/incident-postmortem/SKILL.md and an evals file to disk

evals.prompt: Create a skill named release-notes in skills/release-notes/. It turns a git log (one commit per line, Conventional Commits) into release notes for end users: only user-facing changes, grouped, breaking changes first with what users must do, plain language, PR numbers kept. It should fire when I ask for release notes or a changelog for users from commits. The requirements are final and approved: write the skill and its evals to disk now, no need to ask me anything.
evals.expected_output: A complete skill folder on disk.
assertions: Writes skills/release-notes/SKILL.md and an evals file to disk
